mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_records (employee_id, task_id, start_time, end_time, work_description, created_at) SELECT #{employeeId}, #{taskId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{workDescription}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.id = #{taskId} AND t.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS', 'REVIEW') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id, task_id, start_time, end_time, work_description, created_at FROM time_records ORDER BY start_time
SELECT id, employee_id, task_id, start_time, end_time, work_description, created_at FROM time_records WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY start_time
SELECT id, employee_id, task_id, start_time, end_time, work_description, created_at FROM time_records WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY start_time
